# Phase 2 rules
Read this file and `PROGRESS.md` before any batch numbered 12 or higher, and before `H1`.
- Start phase 2 only after batches 01–11 and 11b–11e are recorded as done in `PROGRESS.md`. If they are not, stop and say which are missing.- UI: show money with `formatMoney` from `value.ts`. Use the classes listed under "Classes available" in `11d-ui-shell-wording.prompt.md`; read only that section. Each row keeps one visible primary action, and other actions go in a `more-menu`. Forms open in a `row-detail` row or a `card`, never inside a table cell. Use plain words: "Paid by", "Split", "owes you", "You owe". A new view goes in the sidebar's "Daily" or "Setup" group.- Entry origin until batch 15 adds `source`: `splitwise` when the entry has `splitwiseExpenseId`, `bank` when `bankRowIds` is not empty, otherwise `manual`. After batch 15, a stored `source` wins.- New records get `crypto.randomUUID()` ids. Before `update`, check a new ledger with `ledgerProblem` from `file-ledger.ts`.- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` still applies. This file adds to it.- Phase 1 files are the base. Extend them. Do not rewrite a view or rename an export. A new parameter must be optional.- If a file or function a prompt names is missing or differs from the prompt, stop and report it. Do not recreate it.- Storage keeps the raw bank description. A display name is shown beside it, never in its place.- Automation fills review rows only. It never edits a saved entry. Every automatic entry stores its source, `ruleId` or `"memory"`, and the user can undo by source.- Real bank or history CSVs never go into code, tests, fixtures, logs, or chat. Use synthetic rows.- Tests stay few: only the ones the prompt names.
